t: Bring Plu the Tightwad 1 Trader's Note.
So, let's begin! For starters, bring me one note from a Free Trader. You'll see right away how grateful I can be!
So, did you get the note?
Awesome! Now here's your new fist weapons!
Bring Plu the Tightwad 2 Trader's Notes.
Moving right along! Now I want you to bring me two more notes. Believe me, you'll like what happens then!
How we doing'? Got more of those notes?
Great! You're turning out to be a great friend! Now here's my end of the bargain!
Bring Plu the Tightwad 4 Trader's Notes.
I see your appetite is growing! So is mine, yeah. This time I need four notes. Can you handle that?
I can't wait to get those notes!
Here they are! That's it, now I've got 'em where I want 'em. I love it when people owe me, yeah... Oh, I almost forgot - here you go!
Bring Plu the Tightwad 6 Trader's Notes.
And now, hmm... If you want to get the best weapon I've got, bring me six more notes! Yeah! This is turning out to be a profitable relationship, isn't it?
Don't take your time! I need those notes!
Ohhh! There's so many! Take this, it's for you! And for me... these dirty, worthless pieces of paper, yeah! I'm basically working at a loss, hehe!

Get permission to talk to Nomarkh Userkaf, the Imperial Supply Officer, at the Eljune Bazaar.

I want to ask you to help with a very important mission. The western part of the Holy Land is called Eljune. The war against the League is not as intense there as it is in Asee-Teph. Because of that, the Free Traders are more numerous in that region.
One of them, a goblin called Plu the Tightwad, has announced a giant auction. He's putting a massive batch of some "holy weapons" up for sale and claims that they have truly amazing properties. He says that even our Imperial scientists can't make anything like them.
The goblin's planning on selling them to the highest bidder. There are only two buyers - us and the League. I don't really believe the goblin's stories, but we can't let the League get their hands on them just in case. That's why I want to send you there.
You'll find Nomarkh Userkaf, the Imperial Supply Officer, at the Eljune Bazaar. That's the Free Traders' main base, and you will assist Nomarkh Userkaf with whatever he needs. I'm counting on you to get the job done.
Ah, reinforcements. Are you here about the holy weapons?
Now it's time to get to work. We convinced the goblin to give us a sample of the weapons to make sure they're genuine, and you're going to test them.
Collect 6 White Yeti Skins. Report back to Stone the Merciless at Eljune Bazaar.

You there, you like getting food and other goods, right? So that means that you want to help the free traders, right?
Wonderful! You've seen the white yetis? These creatures think they are masters of Eljune! Any time a new shipment comes through, they assault our trade caravans!
 Our mercenaries are a bunch of failures... So, white yeti hunting season has been officially declared open. Go kill every single one of them that you come across! Show them what it's like to be assaulted!
Those yetis are bold. I'm sure it won't take long to find them.
Kill 25 Cultist Demon Worshippers or Astral Reavers. Report back to Irina Lazareva on the Zosim Coast.

The Edge of Eternal Night breeds of evil, darkness and death!
The cultists and demons are the masters of that domain. But if we can cleanse this land of them, then we'll only have one enemy to focus on and we can take Tensess Temple for the Empire!
So you know what you must do, right? Your targets are the demons and their little cultist pets! Go teach them a lesson!
Cultists and demons are disgusting and wrong! Show no mercy to them!

Well done!
I know who to call should these creatures ever decide to rear their ugly heads again.
Kill 6 Cultist Demon Worshippers or Astral Reavers. Report back to Miroslav Amvonov on the Zosim Coast.

Well done!
I know who to call should these creatures ever decide to rear their ugly heads again.
Get the needed ingredients, put them into the bottle with the unfinished potion to make Turn Potion which must be brought to Free Trader Charles de Pluie.

A-a-a! I have noticed your steady gaze on the spot! The 4th level... Not bad.
But I do it better than you. I have the 5th! Free Traders can't go without it.
I can teach you, if you like. Now I have some problem, if you help me... I'll help you.
Beast fights that I like so much are... a bit expensive for me. So I need to sell something very quickly. The problem is that I have almost sold everything. I have only the unfinished Turn potion. Very rare thing. I even have the buyer. The only thing is to finish the potion.
I'll tell you what to do. Kill Carnivorous Slugs! And take rare ingredient from them - concentrated protoplasm. When you get 20 pieces, add them to the bottle with the unfinished potion. Your potion will be almost finished.
Then you should kill Mantis Sentinels. And take fossilized chitin from them. When you get 20 pieces, add them to the bottle with the unfinished potion. And you'll get Turn Potion. Bring it to me and I'll do my part of a deal. I play by rules!
Believe me, 5th level of "Steady gaze" ability is a good reward.

Excellent. I'm in again!
Now I'll sell this potion and buy...
I got it, no talking, no hurry. Let's start studies. Beast fights will wait.
Get permission to talk to the Peppy Family at the Eljune Bazaar.

I recently received a very tempting offer. The Free Traders have set up camp in Eljune, the area to the west of Asee-Teph. One of them, a goblin called Plu the Tightwad, has announced an auction.
Apparently, he's selling a massive batch of some sort of "holy weapons" and claims they have "truly amazing properties, the likes of which have never been seen."
Naturally, the Empire has also been invited to participate in the auction. Unfortunately, I can't drop everything I'm doing and go to Eljune.
That's why I want to send you there. These secret weapons must be tested. You'll find the Peppy Family at the Eljune Bazaar, the Free Traders' main camp. The Peppy Family will help you place the bid at the auction and pay for them if these weapons turn out to be real.
We need to make sure the Empire doesn't get their hands on them! These could be what we need to turn the war around. I'm counting on you. Here's a League emissary's certificate - you won't get inside the camp without it.
Are you here about the holy weapons? We've been waiting for you.
We were told you're an expert in weapons and armor. That means you'll be a huge help!
Kill 5 Elven players and return to Yasskul Minkhaf.

Oh, how I hate them! No, not the demons. Well, I hate them too, but I'm talking about the Elves! They're vapid, vain, and extremely stupid! Everything we Arisen hate!
Don't ask me how they're any good at magic. I suppose they're just born with natural talent, something that most of them waste! And to think that the League considers them the most skilled mages in the world. Pah!
You look like a battle-hardened soldier. How about you go out and kill a few? Or even better, a ton! I would be so grateful to never see one of those condescending sneers again. Oh, how I dream of ripping off their wings one by one...
Well? Are they still fluttering around out there or what?
That'll show those blasted pansies! Thank you for taking care of them.
Guard the Bloody outpost for 5 minutes and return to Stas Litvinov.

An assault could begin at any moment! That's why I'm recruiting you! The task is simple. Listen carefully.
First of all, you have to remain at the Bloody outpost for five minutes. Desertion from the battlefield is one of the most grievous crimes!
Second, Obuk the Righteous is going to be at your aid. He will certainly become the main target of the League if an assault begins.
Last thing, you must survive! Dead men don't help out on the battlefield! You die, you fail your mission.
Is everything clear? Good, now get over to that gate and keep your eyes peeled.
The Imperial Army instills incredible discipline into its soldiers. That is how we can defeat any foe!
Excellent! You keep a vigilant watch there, soldier! Keep up the good work!
Participate in killing Margo de Ardeur at the Bloody outpost and report back to Stas Litvinov.

Dammit! The League has taken control of the Bloody outpost! They came at us with a horde of soldiers and defeated our troops! They don't know any better!
Unfortunately I was wounded early in the fight, so all I could do was hide in these bushes and watch them slaughter my men.
Do you want to serve the Empire?
The easiest way to recapture the gate is to send that League commander to Purgatory! Her name is Margo de Ardeur, and she's far from being a frail little lady. Be prepared for her to put up a fight. I'm sure you can manage, right?
How many times have we battled for this barricade? I think I've lost count...
Excellent! As soon as we beheaded their army all the League soldiers crumbled. Keep it up! The Motherland won't forget your deeds!
Kill 5 Orcish players and return to Stanislav Kubarev.

You've already taken out so many Imperial soldiers. A couple more should be no problem for you, so why don't you lend a hand.
The ones that are really giving us problems are the Orcs. They're disgusting, filthy creatures who should be kept on leashes! They care for nothing but blood and battle. I want you to go and kill a whole group of them and report back to me when you are victorious.
Well? I won't stand for anything less than five dead Orcs!
Well done! The fewer of those brutish creatures there are, the better!
Guard the Bloody outpost for 5 minutes and return to Stas Litvinov.

The Empire is preparing for an assault!
I have three orders that you must follow immediately! First, keep watch at the barricade and don't leave it for a second! Secondly, help protect our Commander, Margo de Ardeur! Those Imperial hounds will no doubt try to kill her, so you must thwart their plans at any cost!
The last order is to survive. That's right, I won't accept any deaths around here! We can't give them even an inch! Well, what are you waiting for? In the name of the Light, defend our soil!
The orders are clear and understandable. So, go get to work!
Wonderful! You were able to complete all three tasks!
Participate in killing Obuk the Righteous at the Bloody outpost and report back to Stas Litvinov.

Tensess help us! If it weren't for my injuries... If it weren't for their treacherous attack from the rear... If it weren't for hundreds of Imperial fanatics eagerly throwing themselves on our blades, all in the name of Nezeb...
What I'm trying to say is, the Empire has captured the barricade! We must reclaim it! We must kill their captain! Imperial soldiers are nothing more than a flock of sheep, and without a shepherd they will immediately lose control!
Getting to the brute won't be easy, and killing him will be even harder. But you'll manage - I believe in you! Now go, and may the Light be with you!
Do you do it? Where's the chaos? Where's the carnage?
Excellent! The Bloody outpost is ours! Look at them running around down there. They have no idea what's going on.
Find Semer Nemar in Yasker's Tower and ask him about the runes.

I sense a lot of strength in you... Strength that gives you the opportunity not only to earn the good grace of the Patron, but also his runes!
What? You don't know what runes are yet? Go immediately to Nezebgrad and find Semer Nemar the rune merchant in Yasker's Tower.
He will teach you to work with runes, and your power will increase many times over!

You are interested in runes?
And so you should be! You have several courses of action.
The first is to ask me about the runes.
The second is to perform several quests and find out for yourself how it all works.
The third is to reconcile yourself to the fact that you will always lose, and go on your way.
I recommend you to take the first and second options.
Do you agree? Excellent. Then, here is a clean rune for you. Clasp it in your hand, and it will turn into a rune of your Patron. And I will tell you right now how to use it.
Find the Mysterious Family in the Gibberling District of Novograd and ask them about the runes.

The time has come for you to visit the rune merchants. They will teach you to work with runes. Carry out their quest and you will learn a lot more about runes and how to use their power.
Go to Novograd and find the Mysterious Family in the Gibberling district. If anybody knows all the properties of runes, it is them!

Welcome!
After acquiring their patron, many people come to us for advice. You want to find out more about runes? We can tell you all about that. And also teach you the nuances of working with them.
Let's start with giving you a clean rune of the first level. Touch it, clasp it in your hand, and it will become the rune of your Patron. Do not throw it away! You will need it.
Bring 20 Buttons to Mamuk the Burly.

Come over here. Stand next to me. Don't let anyone see us talking.

Have you seen my goods already? Cool stuff, right? All these can be yours as soon as you earn the trust of the Free Traders - and mine.

Usually it takes a lot of sweating, but you are lucky. You have me!

Here is the deal - bring me 20 buttons and I will tell everyone that you are the best friend of the Free Traders. Where do you get buttons? From the tailors, of course.

Remember, if somebody finds out about our conversation, you are no longer a friend of mine. Don't tell anyone about the buttons!
All those who bring me buttons ask what I use them for, but that's a trade secret!
Buttons! How I love buttons! You are the most beautiful things on earth! ...What? Oh, here's your coin. The Free Traders will remember your help. Thanks.
Obtain 6 clumps of Dark Astral Energy from the cultists or demons and bring them to Zosim Nikulin.

Hold on a second. Let me get a good look at you.

Hm...

There's plenty of blood on your hands, but I don't see darkness in your heart. That means you will be able to forge an even stronger bond with your patron.

The Twelve Great Martyrs had to fight the darkness a long time ago when the Great Cataclysm occurred. Yes, that's right - darkness!

You'll soon have the opportunity to see for yourself. You'll have to, if you want to complete the Patronage ritual. There are plenty of demons and their minions here on Eljune. And many of them should have remnants of this dark Astral energy clinging to them! Collect six clumps and bring them to me. Then I'll know you understand what we're up against.
So? Have you collected the clumps of dark Astral energy?

Yes... these are what I was talking about. Can you see how they radiate darkness? And how that darkness in intricately entwined with the Astral? This is what the Martyrs were up against long ago, and this is what almost destroyed all of Sarnaut. Now it is time to proceed.
Collect 3 Cursed Rune Fragments from the Cursed Treants and return to Zosim Nikulin.

Next you must bring me a rune. One that has been imbued with the magic of the Light and can be considered truly blessed. The runes are very rare indeed. In fact, even I have only found a few.
However, I think I know a way that I can create a Blessed Rune if you're not able to find one by other means. It'll be fairly dangerous, but I'm sure that if you manage to gather a few friends willing to help, you will be able to succeed.
Long ago I helped to bless many of the treants in this forest. They were to be the guardians of Eljune and help uphold the ideals of the Light. In order to complete the proper rituals, I gave them many of the Blessed Runes.
The treants performed their duties well for a very long time. However, they were recently tainted by the spreading darkness. If you defeat these monsters, you should be able to find some fragments of the runes they were originally given.
Bring these fragments to me and I should be able to remove any darkness from them. From there I'll be able to combine them to create one Blessed Rune.
How goes the search for the rune fragments?
After I purify these fragments I'll be able to create one Blessed Rune. Then we can proceed with the rest of the preparations.
Bring a level 1 Rune of Ulf to Zosim Nikulin.

Lastly, you must bring me a rune that is imbued with your patron's power. I can see that you are aligned with the Great Martyr Ulf, so it is his rune you must seek.
Return to me as quickly as possible when you have the rune. This ritual cannot wait, for every day the darkness spreads farther into our lands.
Did you get a Rune of Ulf?
Now you have all that you need to reach the fourth level of patronage. Let us begin.

Use the Clot of Dark Astral Energy at the Edge of Eternal Night to summon an Enraged Demon Mage, kill it, and return to Zosim Nikulin.

Now you shall prove to your patron that you are not only pure of soul, but also determined to fight the dark influence of the Astral - just as he did. Take this clot of dark Astral energy - it has been influenced by the holy powers of the runes that you brought me, and its power is beginning to fade.
At the Edge of Eternal Night there is a large Astral crystal on the far western part of the shore. There the energy of the Astral is very strong. Focus on your faith, and the demons will begin to sense that their power is being challenged. Then one of them will undoubtedly challenge you for committing such an act.
Your patron will also sense what you are doing, and will watch with approval as you battle their age-old enemy. Then you will strengthen the bond with your patron, so that you may continue your crusade against the evils the Astral holds.
I trust that you will not flee from this trial, but instead embrace the opportunity to fight against the demonic forces.

I had no doubt that you would succeed. As soon as I met you I could tell that you had a pure heart and an iron resolve. With your new level of patronage, you should be a formidable weapon against the demons.

Hmm... This appears to be an ancient stele. Despite the fact that it is heavily eroded, it still pulses with magical energy. Maybe you should check the cracks and crevices of this structure - there could be a treasure hidden inside!

Wow! This appears to be an ancient chest! Perhaps it was left by the June people, or perhaps it was left by another inhabitant of Sarnaut.
Maybe they thought the magical energy would protect their treasures. You should open it as quickly as possible!
Find the treasure in the June ruins. Report back to Shysh the Wind at Eljune Bazaar.

I am a messenger. I'm fast as the wind. I fly like an arrow through the forests of Eljune. And it keeps me alive.
Once I was running past the June ruins which you call June Itsmal... Or maybe those were some other ruins, I can't remember! But there are no Junes in the ruins these days, only forest trolls. And I saw one creepy troll digging around an ancient stele. He noticed me and rushed after me! But can a troll catch up with Shysh the Wind?! No way!
But I'm still terribly curious why he was poking around under that stele. Maybe you can check?
Well? Have you found this treasure?
Just as I suspected. These objects are nothing more than pretty trinkets. The most valuable things can be found all around us, in nature itself.
Find the 6 Stones of Eljune and report back to anthropologist Mezga the Studious.

To be able to call yourself a true scholar, you must be very aware of your surroundings.
As a test, I have placed six stones imbued with magic around Eljune. Explore this great area, find the stones and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones in the Maddox Depot, Kotelny Camp, Icemirror Lake, Wispwood Forest, Itsmal Ruins, and Wilderwoods. Good luck, traveler.
What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.
Great! You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!
Collect 7 Eljune Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Mezga the Studious.

Hey, I know you're a seasoned traveler, but Eljune is a very dangerous place!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill 7 of Eljune's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of Shadowscreech, Darkhorn, a ferocious grizzly bear, an icy scorpion, a ferocious werewolf, a wobbly satyr, a lake lizard tidecaller, a ravenous mountain gar, a fierce ashy wolf, a pulsing ether elemental, a vicious pike, an enraged cemetery zombie, a cursed will-o'-the-wisp... And so on and so forth...
Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.
Kill 125 Fierce Werewolves or Fierce Werebears and report back to anthropologist Mezga the Studious.

Eljune is almost perfect. Just take a look around! This place is great!
But did you notice that I said "almost?" That's right. This place would be amazing if not those werewolves and werebears! They're not really people and they're not really beasts... They're just awful! Go show them who the true masters of Eljune are!
Those werewolves tremble at the sound of your name now, right?
Thank you! This place is looking better all ready!
Collect 20 Princeberries for anthropologist Mezga the Studious.

What do you think the most valuable part of Eljune is? I bet you can't figure it out.
I'm talking about Princeberries, of course! You've heard of them, right? Just one little berry is enough to quench your thirst for an entire day!
It used to be a well guarded forestfolk secret, but now that the traders are here, we can sell them for profit! No longer will the forestfolk live in poverty! But I can't leave my post, so I need you to go out there and get me some for the traders!
The princeberries are everywhere! You just need to look hard!
Oh, look at how many! The forestfolk thank you!
Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Mezga the Studious.

If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in Eljune!
Have you completed all of my tasks?

Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!
Find the 6 Stones of Coba Plateau and report back to anthropologists Marjana Kraeva.

You probably know that there's not much in Coba Plateau outside of the war and the artifacts, but you probably don't know about the stones.
Ah-ha! See, you didn't. There are six stones hidden around Coba Plateau and if you want to learn, then you need to find them!
But don't worry, they won't be too hard to find. They're pretty big and they have some sort of inscription on them. Oh, and they float! You can find them in Meridian Outback, Rusted Wasteland, Giant's Table, Midnight Shore, Spectral Gorge and Southern Bank. Good luck!
What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.
Great! You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!
Collect 8 Coba Plateau Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Marjana Kraeva.

Yeah, yeah... I know you're a seasoned traveler, but Coba Plateau is a very dangerous place!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill 5 of Coba Plateau's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of Laxna, Skreekaz, a goblin espionage agent, a kobold ripper, a brawny kobold, an aggressive rhinoceros bull, a vicious tomb skeleton, a vicious grave skeleton, a rusty skeleton captain, a giant steppe scorpion... And so on and so forth...
Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.
Kill 150 Goblins and report back to anthropologist Marjana Kraeva.

Listen, who do you think give us prospectors the most trouble around here?
The soldiers? No, the war never usually makes it this far. The bandits? Pshh. Those guys are amateurs.
It's the goblins, of course! They barge in causing all sorts of problems and stealing the artifacts! So I want you to get out there and teach those no-good goblins a lesson!
Those goblins tremble at the sound of your name now, right?
Thank you! I'm sure we'll have no problems from them now!
Find 10 Prospectors' Documents and report back to anthropologist Marjana Kraeva.

There's only one resource here that's truly valuable. Can you guess what it is?
Isn't it obvious? It's the artifacts!
But, actually, that's not what I'm sending you after. There are a lot of prospectors that go out searching for the artifacts and never return. We need to notify their families and help them to retain their memories. The prospectors all carry documents that identify them for just such an occasion. I need you to go out and find these documents!
Help us preserve the prospectors' memories! Find their poor bones, you might be able to find their documents on them.
Oh, Ivan Mossov... Vladlen Foxin... Thunder the Forester... Yaver Glar...So many names!
Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Marjana Kraeva.

If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in Coba Plateau!
Have you completed all of my tasks?

Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!
Take the Magpie Helper from Yaver Qar temporarily

Hey! Listen to me, I've got something for you.
Can you see this magpie circling around? This bird annoys me so much, I'm losing my patience. It brings me junk all the time - why would I need that? I just want to focus on my job for a second!
You know, magpies like that are sold from the Boutique. They are trained to bring loot to their owner. But I don't need any loot!
Could you give this bird a home maybe? I can tell that you are used to picking up stuff, you will surely find use in this helper.

Thanks a lot! So you say this magpie gathered all that loot for you? Well, sounds useful for busy adventurers!
If you want a permanent magpie helper for yourself, you can buy it from the Boutique.
Find 3 Zem device components and 3 barrels of Zem lube and bring them to Yaver Qar to Prospectors' Inn.

My path to Coba Plateau was not so easy. I've come through a lot of perils. Something is out of order, became rusty and carious. Need a repair.
As you may know, it is very difficult to get something in this backwoods. My tribesmen don't want to talk to me because of... Well, now it's another story.
But I know that someone saw few broken Tep Blades in the steppe. And barrels with lube. I badly need all this stuff.
Find three barrels of Zem lube and three Zem device components and bring me. As a reward... hm... I know a lot... You want to get something valuable, don't you?
Well, let me teach you the last level of "Steady gaze" ability.
Agreed?
While you are travelling across Coba Plateau be careful. May be you'll come across what I need.

Yes, I'll need this stuff.
Now I will fulfill my part of a deal.
I always fulfill my duties, ha-ha...
Teach the magpie how to collect loot by summoning it and killing 12 Kobolds.

Hey you! Yeah, yeah, I'm talking to you! I got a job for you.
See the magpie circling me? It's freaking me out! It keeps bothering me by bringing some junk... Meanwhile, I'm busy solving an extremely difficult problem, but the noisy bird just won't let me focus for a second!
Truth be told, magpies are smart birds. They are valued by experienced adventurers. They can be tamed and taught to bring loot to their owner. Yet I don't fight anyone or collect any loot, though it keeps bringing me some trash.
Want to take the bird with you? It'll be of great use if you can train it. Which isn't very hard. Let's say there are some Kobolds running around. Once you defeat one, gold will drop from his pockets. Well, a magpie doesn't need to be told what to do with gold. Show it what's what a dozen times or so, and it'll get it. Think you can handle it? Then it's yours!
So, did you manage to tame the birdie? That's great. Keep it. I wish I never saw it!
Kill 5 Gibberling players and return to Steeler the Righteous.

Listen up! We've got a real problem. It's those blasted Gibberlings! They're worse than the wild animals around here. They're just as quick and ten times as deadly! And don't even get me started on their looks.
It's disgusting. Something needs to be done about them and I think you're just the person to do it. Go kill five groups of those monstrosities and return to me on the double, soldier!
...Just looking at them makes me feel sick.
Great! The less cute things there are, the better!
Kill 5 Arisen players and return to the Gallant Family.

Look, we've got a real problem here. It's those damn Arisen! They keep running past here, jumping on stuff, and... Well... They're just plain ugly! Look at them! Their flesh is practically falling off their bones and they've got these greasy robotic limbs! It just isn't right!
Something needs to be done about this and we know just what it is. They need to be exterminated! Go and kill five of those monsters and show them what they really are - corpses!
Wonderful! I hated hearing those squeaky gears moving as they ran by.
Punish 3 Umoiran Rookies and return to the Gallant Family.

The first thing we've got to do is stop the bullying and the bigotry. We just got a new unit in from Umoira, and we never would have thought that such a backwater and ignorant allod could still exist!
The governor of Umoira teaches his citizens that Kanians are the heart and soul of the League, while the Elves are a vapid people that only care about their own agenda. Gibberlings are considered funny little animals that have descended from the trees to serve the Kanians! There is no end to our indignation!
The Umoiran unit arrived not too long ago but they're already bullying the Gibberlings. We've got no choice but to teach them the basics of tolerance and friendliness, but we're afraid they understand nothing but force. Do you think you could teach them a lesson?

In regards to the Umoirans' opinion about the Elves... Well, we finally agreed that it might not be far from the truth, but we can't raise our young ones with that kind of attitude! We firmly say "No!" to racism!
You have our thanks, as both commanders and Gibberlings.
Bring 4 Dark Artifacts to Afanasy Firov.

All that the soldiers are talking about is where they managed to steal artifacts. Those damned heretics aren't even ashamed to do it right in front of me!
The darkness has consumed their souls! I told the Gallant Family that what we need is a few fires. The sight of a few charred corpses will quickly change our warriors' attitudes towards these artifacts. Unfortunately, our military commanders are too soft...
Your orders from the Church are as follows - go through the soldiers' things and confiscate any and all dark artifacts that you find.
You are to obtain these artifacts at any cost. If they try to stop you, your hand shall not falter - slay them in the name of the Church of Light!
I sense darkness all around us! It has nestled into the souls of the League's sons and daughters! We must remove it immediately!
My heart aches at the sight of how low our warriors have fallen... Excommunication shall be the fate of all those who brings dark artifacts into the camp!
Collect 6 Spider Legs for the Steamy Family.

We're struggling to keep up, there's just too many soldiers to feed. The regiment's suppliers were not prepared to deal with this many men. Reinforcements are great but our soldiers need to eat too!
Can you keep a secret? We've been hunting the local spiders and making a soup out of them. The spiders around here are skin and bones, but what can you do? They're one of the only sources of food we could find.
Since you're here, could you help us out by bringing back some spider legs? Just don't tell anyone we're making spider soup... That could start a mutiny!
If you don't feed your own army, it won't be long before you're feeding the enemy's!
These legs look great! Thanks to you we might last another day.
Collect 5 Water Samples for Helene de Grandeur.

How are you feeling? Any stomach pains? How's your stool? Well, that's something new! Someone who's not sick!
The soldiers have been complaining about abdominal pains lately. They've been spending most of their time in the bushes... I think it's the water. We don't have any fresh drinking water here, so it has to be delivered in barrels from the north.
I have no idea where the water comes from. There might have been corpses are floating around in it for all I know! Please take these flasks and fill them with water from each of the barrels. I need to test it right away.
I try not to drink from these barrels myself. Imagine what would happen if their healer, a beautiful Elf, came down with a terrible case of diarrhea...
Thank you so much! I have a small set of lab equipment so I'll test the water right now.
Kill 6 Imperial Spies on the Midnight Shore and find out what they're looking for on the ship. Report back to the Gallant Family.

An Imperial ship has run ashore not far from here. Everything of value has already been looted by our soldiers and smugglers, but Imperial spies have recently been spotted near the ship wreck. Obviously, they must be eliminated! But there's something else...
The most important thing is to find out what they're looking for.
We don't know what the Empire's scouts are looking for on that damaged ship...

Looks like the scouts were searching for this document. Let's have a look at it. Wow! A scout report. Okay... they investigated "Object 1" which had been seized by "rats..." what the heck are "rats?" They searched it from top to bottom but they haven't found out how to get around the magical barrier. The scout leader then asks that his boys don't have their bonuses taken away...
I'm sure that "Object 1" is Tep's Pyramid, which would make the "rats" cultists.
Fortunately for us, it looks like the Empire's scouts are as bad as ours.
Find 3 Dark Artifacts to Afanasy Firov.

You'll will no doubt find Dark Artifacts in the smuggler camp on the shore.
These Artifacts have tempted our warriors more than once and you can be sure that it's planted a tiny, dark seed in their minds.
Take the Artifacts out of the camp and I'll hide them away. The Church will then destroy these vessels of darkness.
I can't even look at the artifacts for more than a few seconds before I start to shake. How someone could actually try to find them, I'll never understand.
Hand them over quickly - I need to lock them up!
Collect 6 Recruit Badges for Afanasy Firov.

It's obvious that many of the League recruits are here to sell dark artifacts. Their souls have become so consumed by the darkness that they're attacking their own kind.
Killing the traitors and bringing their badges to Afanasy Firov will prove their disloyalty and reveal this internal threat.

Wow! You even managed to deal with the heartless bastards that sell artifacts to the smugglers? It's a good thing that those bad apples met their deaths on the shore where they can't corrupt anyone else.
We just have to think of the best way of letting the other soldiers know that this path will not lead them to anything good.
Post 5 copies of the Inquisitor's Call up in the League camp.

Listen, I've written out a call to our warriors - "They tried to profit off the Dark Artifacts and their souls have been consumed by the Astral forever. Everyone that allows himself to be seduced by the darkness and forgets that he is a Warrior of Light in the rush for gold will share their same fate! Signed, The Great Inquisitor."
Sounds great, right? Post five copies of it up around the camp.
The sight of my call and these badges will give our other warriors a wake-up call that should last a while. But then again, a charred corpse on a fire would have painted a more impressive picture...
The job is done! It looks like soldiers are already reading the call and scratching their heads - that's right, they're finally thinking about things!
Collect 6 pieces of Sailcloth for the Steamy Family.

There has been very little space in the barracks for some time now so we're housing our reinforcements in tents. Unfortunately, even those are starting to run out.
The good news is - we've got an idea! The remains of an Imperial ship are located to the north along the Astral shore. It ran aground recently, so there may still be some sailcloth in its holds.
The sailcloth would be really handy for constructing makeshift tents! If our soldiers have no roofs over their heads, we can't keep them healthy and ready for battle. Do you think you could get that sailcloth?
We just gave the order to fill the last bunk. Now we have nowhere else to put the soldiers!
This sailcloth should come in real handy! Thank you!
Gather 4 Pieces of Manganese for Helene de Grandeur.

Unfortunately, my analysis confirms that the water is indeed the cause of our health problems. But then again, I suppose that we should be thankful that it isn't something even more awful. The water probably just gets a little spoiled on the way here due to the heat.
Fortunately I know how to purify the water - manganese! I even know where to get it, but it's a job for a real warrior... one like you!
There are some elementals that live to the south of here. I've heard soldiers complaining about how difficult they are to kill because they're made of stone. Rock chips they brought back confirmed that they're made of manganese, so please bring me back a few chunks.
Manganese is a natural filter that will purify the water. This will allow me to do my real job - treating combat wounds, not upset stomachs!
Thank you for your help. A new batch of water barrels has just arrived. Now I can deal with it before the soldiers start drinking it.
Capture the Zem Crypt in the Rusted Wasteland for Steeler the Righteous in the Imperial Camp.

Our troops have encountered heavy League resistance in the Rusted Wasteland. Both sides are fighting for control of the Wasteland, the only source of Dark Artifacts this side of the Cordon.
Capturing the ruins is a matter of life and death. There are two natural fortifications there in the shape of Zem crypts... Well, now that I think about it, that's not very natural. Your orders are to secure a crypt and clear it of League forces. Do that and the Wasteland is ours!
What's the situation in the Rusted Wasteland? Did you manage to kick some League ass?
Right, tell me everything about it... A great victory! I'll order the scribe to write up a little report about this fight to send to the capitol!
Capture the Zem crypt in the Rusted Wasteland for the Gallant Family in the League camp.

Fierce fighting has broken out in the Rusted Wasteland. It's near an ancient Zem ruin that has spawned anomalies in the area. It's a place where magic has twisted the laws of metaphysics and now all sorts of trouble brews there... Including the Dark Artifacts.
They say that other anomalies can be found east of here, beyond the Cordon, but they're all well guarded by goblins. That's why the League must fight the Empire over control of the Rusted Wasteland.
It's time to knock the enemy out of there! There are two fortifications in the Wasteland that happen to be Zem crypts. Your mission is simple - clear the crypt of Imperial forces and establish control over it.
There's one other thing... The Church strictly forbids the collection and use of artifacts found in the ruins... But in war, anything goes. If the artifacts help you defeat the enemy - then that means they serve the Light. Just don't tell the Great Inquisitor... He might not understand.
We can't let those Imperial bastards hide in the crypts. It's too close to our camp!
The Imperial forces have been cleared out of the crypts? Glory to the League!
Find 6 Magical Poison Glands for Afanasy Firov.

We've already collected Dark artifacts in our own camp and from the smugglers. The tipping point in the war against this disease is upon us. The root of this evil is in the crypts to the south of here.
I'm talking about the Rusted Wasteland. Those ancient ruins are a source of darkness.
Then we have the anomalies of the Coba Plateau - strange things happen there. Or this Rusted Wasteland. Do you know why it's called that? Because here your gear will quickly rust through. It will turn into useless tin crumpling under blows.
The Church is giving you another mission. The Rusted Wasteland is known for its cursed artifacts. Collect as many as you can carry. Six at least. You can find them anywhere: in the ruins, bushes, or just lying on the ground. There's one known as Magical Poison Gland!
A gland... How disgusting!
You're heading into the epicenter of darkness. Be wary of the temptation to use the damned artifacts! Be careful and remember my words!

From now on darkness cannot get into the camp from those damned ruins! It's time to call a wagon.
We'll take these artifacts into the empty prairie and destroy them.
Use the Deadman's Eye to reveal the heretics and bring 5 Packages of Dark Artifacts to Afanasy Firov.

There's something else... Even though we've gone through the soldier's chests, many warriors who are currently at the Rusted Wasteland are likely to bring back new artifacts.
Searching each and every one of them wouldn't be the best idea... Many soldiers are still loyal to the Light, only a handful will go down the wrong path. I'm getting strange looks as it is, so we must act covertly.
Take this charm - it responds to the darkness. When a soldier isn't looking, use it on him, and if it reveals a heretic, show him no mercy! Kill him in the name of the Light and take his artifact away.
I'd like to believe that the soldiers who bring back artifacts are few and far between, but in truth, they're probably in the majority!
Good, now we can rest. You have rid the camp of this disease and the Light shall stay with you forever.
Bring 3 Scorpion Stingers to Ratta the Muddy.

Hey, Ratta has some real valuable information for you!
Three moons back, I left the mines of my people and came to this plateau. Now, instead of mining black coal, I'm getting my hands on shiny gold! I can teach you how to do it. Do you want to know how?
I'm sure you do, but I'm not telling all my secrets to a stranger! Ratta may be an outcast but he's not stupid. Bring me artifacts from the anomalies. There are terrible monsters here protecting them and Ratta is afraid of dying.
Get me the artifacts called scorpion stingers and I'll tell you how to get gold!
Don't be afraid. My information is worth it! Ratta may be an outcast but he's no liar! Did you bring the scorpion stingers?

Ratta left his people and became happy and rich. You should forget about your people and this stupid war, too. There's a tavern in the center of the plateau called the Prospectors' Inn and that's where we Prospectors get together.
We are free spirits, working only for ourselves, going where we choose to and drinking as much ale as we want. The Traders at the inn pay us a lot of gold for artifacts. Ratta will put in a good word for you with the folks there and you'll be accepted without a hitch. Now it's time to pay for that information!
Kill 6 Rusty Skeletons in the Rusted Wasteland for Anton Loktev.

My unit was sent in to clear the crypts. We entered the first one but found it full of skeletons, not Imperial forces!
The war had awakened them and since my unit is full of rookies, who've never seen the undead, they got scared pretty quick. Those bony bastards put some heat on us and my boys turned tail and ran! Go deal with the skeletons while I get the soldiers back together. After that experience, I'm sure they'll be delighted to fight against the Empire!
Go kill the Imperial bastards and the skeletons. These milksops are struggling to keep their trousers clean out here...
Don't think too badly of my boys... They're green as a tree, but tomorrow they'll have those Imperial scum running back to the Cordon with their tails between their legs!
Whip 3 Penal Battalion Soldiers and return to Steeler the Righteous.

They send me these useless good-for-nothings and they expect me to defeat the League forces in the Rusted Wasteland? Can you believe that the last batch of reinforcements they sent me was from a penal battalion? What was headquarters thinking when they sent these idiots to a crucial location in the war?
The penal battalion is full of deserters, past and future! Once a traitor, always a traitor. They had barely arrived at the camp when they started a mutiny! A few managed to escape but we'll find them!
My boys caught a few of them - they're over there by the wall. Take this whip and give them a few lashes. I don't even want to touch them!
There's no sweeter sound that the moans of a pathetic traitor!
They got just what they deserve! Now they might think twice before deserting again.
Interrogate 3 Goblin Workers for Semer Kiya.

How could this have happened?! I hardly ever stop watching the warehouse, I pretty much sleep here now! And yet today's check indicates that more artifacts are missing!
That's it! It's obvious that the guards are involved - those three Xadaganians seemed like loyal soldiers, but now that I think about it they've been spending a lot of time with the goblin construction workers.
The goblins are very shifty... Could they be working with the mafia? We need to check it out as soon as possible! Go interrogate three of them and return to me.
Where are the warehouse guards? I haven't seen them for a while. I bet they're hanging around those goblins again!
So that's it... my guards sold out to the mafia. Strange, I'm usually good at reading people.
What's wrong? I don't know anything!
Kill 6 Dusty Termites for Crazybrick the Fierce in the Imperial Camp.

Ugh, this never ends, does it?! We get ourselves a huge camp, even bigger than the League. We erect strong walls around it and have already received orders to expand. Life is good, right? Wrong! We're getting our butts handed to us by bugs! Termites, to be precise. Those little bastards stole all our building materials!
Life has a great sense of humor. A brainless bug is the eager beaver, while the goblins are freeloading loafers.
You know, I wouldn't mind getting me a crew of those termites to manage, if only they had some gold to pay me and minimal capacity to take orders. Who wouldn't want workers like that? Day and night they're hauling our lime, building up their mounds. I'd admire them if I didn't hate them so much! Alas, I manage a crew of dimwitted goblins...
And what are you doing just standing there! Go and kill some termites around the camp!
Damnit! Those lazy goblins only work when you push them, and the minute you get things rolling, you run out of limestone! Where is it? The termites stole it!

You're not a goblin, that's obvious, you're useful!
Hey, you ugly little bastards, get to work before I break your pathetic little limbs! You're not going to be blaming the termites for anything no more! Get to work! Today's work shift ends tomorrow morning!
Fire the Combustion Climax and return to Semer Sanakht.

Hey you, come here a second, I need your help. You can tell Steeler and Semer Kiya to lay off for a while, from here on out you'll be serving science - the vanguard of civilization!
So, our objective is to study, systematize, and classify the Dark Artifacts. I am currently analyzing the function of an artifact known in common parlance as a "Combustion Climax." Don't be fooled - this silly and somewhat childish name conceals an object that invokes a wave of terror. It'll make anyone within its range flee instantly.
That was essentially just an excerpt from my report. There's just one thing I don't understand - what causes the artifact to go off at all? There seem to be some required conditions for its use. That is what we must find out. Try to use the Combustion Climax in the various parts of the camp and report to me on the results. Is your objective clear?
Oh, sorry, I was just thinking about something else and... Anyway, did the artifact work at all?
It worked by the fire, eh? "High temperature is a requisite condition for an artifact such as the ‘Combustion Climax' to function." Let's record that right here.
Find and kill 6 fugitive soldiers on the southern shore for Steeler the Righteous in the Imperial Camp.

Now let's turn our attention to the numerous traitors that managed to escape.
I doubt that those paltry cowards made it very far. There are too many wild animals and League militia around. My gut tells me that those bastards are still around.
Have a look around the camp. Better yet, head south and check out a series of caves down by the shore. I bet that's where those turncoats are holed up - I can smell their stink from here!

Is there anything more shameful for a soldier than death from a blow in the back?
All defectors shall die a dog's death!
All the guilty penal battalion soldiers have been punished. Let it be a good lesson to the rest... Now we can move on to a more serious operation.
Kill 3 Goblin Agents and find any ties that they might have with the mafia for Semer Kiya.

I guess the old saying is true after all - a goblin can't change his spots! I told Steeler not to hire them! Our goblins are in touch with their kind on the other side of the Cordon, I'm sure of it!
Several penal battalion soldiers fled the camp, which is another problem entirely, but when they left I hear that three goblins went with them. It's possible that they've stuck together and holed up somewhere. The road to the Cordon is tough, even for a hardened warrior, so it's going to be much harder for a weak goblin.
The escaped goblins must still be nearby. They must be punished as a lesson to others, but not before they're shaken down for valuable information!
Birds of a feather flock together! No wonder the escaped goblins are joining up with the penal battalion soldiers.
A letter in the goblin language? Nezeb take me! I know Elven, five different Orcish dialects, the forestfolk tongue, troll sign language, but... but not goblin!
Kill the Termite Queen and destroy 6 of her eggs in the Termite Mound for Crazybrick the Fierce.

The worksite is beautiful! It almost makes me want to shed a tear. Those filthy goblins only understand one language - fear! But listen, I have an idea...
The termites are gone for the moment, but you know they'll just come back again and again. Until we burn their whole mound to the ground!
We need to focus on killing their queen! She's that nasty hag that lays eggs day and night. Slay her and all her eggs and then the termites will be history... Brief and bloody history.

Scumbag! Oh, no, not you, that goblin right there! Why'd you put that trowel down? If you don't pick that up I'm gonna shove it where the sun don't shine!
What termites? They ain't by the wall no more! And they'll be gone for good before long! Now, get to work, you freak of nature!

I've forgotten just how many people I've asked to kill the termite queen, but only you have actually managed to do it! I can't believe it!
Now I can finally forget about those bugs and focus on the...
Ugh, who taught you to lay lime, dummy! Do you think I'm blind?! No, these goblins will positively drive me mad! What was I saying... Oh yeah, thank you so much!
Find 4 Crates of Tools for Crazybrick the Fierce.

I've got another job for you. Turns out the termites not only snatched the lime, but also a number of boxes full of tools – paint brushes, trowels, rollers, that kind of thing.
We still have some left, but plenty of goblins are sitting around without work. That's a recipe for disaster with their lazy butts! Go look for our boxes in the termite mound - we need to get them back. Nezeb knows when we'll get replacements in this wilderness...
You want to know what I did to the goblin whose job it was to guard the tools? I'm not sure that your psyche is strong enough to listen to that...
This is great, now I can put those goblins back to work! Thanks so much!
Use the Magical Poison Gland on 6 scorpions for Semer Sanakht. Then collect 6 softened shells for Semer Sanakht.

The next artifact we'll be testing is called a "Magical Poison Gland."
Behind this weird and kind of gross name lies a magical object that'll weaken and soften the opponent's body. Those are the rumors, anyway. I've yet to see the effect of this artifact in person.
Now, we won't be testing it on anyone here in the camp. Go over to the shore and test the Magical Poison Gland on the scorpions.
I wonder what a softened scorpion shell looks like...
I'm very interested to see if this artifact will affect the flesh through a thick and powerful shell. Or maybe even affect the shell itself? That would be even more interesting...

What?! They need to be dead first?! So the Magical Poison Glad had the expected effect on the scorpion shell...
But the flesh wasn't affected whatsoever! Interesting.
Find 6 Magical Poison Glands in the Rusted Wasteland for Semer Kiya in the Imperial Camp.

The main source of the Dark Artifacts is the Rusted Wasteland, beyond Kobold Knoll, just north of here. To be more precise, there's an anomaly there who's magic has altered the space around it and is creating artifacts.
The League and Imperial forces are currently engaged in a ferocious struggle for this area. We can use the confusion to our advantage, make our way in there and restock the Imperial depot with a new batch of artifacts!

There are plenty of artifacts in the Rusted Wasteland and you have my permission to use them against the enemy.
But Nezeb help you if I find out that you've been selling them on the side! Remember, any artifact that finds its way into a Trader's hands can be turned against the Empire at any moment!

Excellent, now let me lock these artifacts away in the depot.
I've already recruited new guards, this time of all different races - a Xadaganian, an Orc, and an arisen. I'm banking on them being suspicious of one another and thus keeping their eyes open at all times...
Find the 3 Mafia Stashes on the Southern Bank for Semer Kiya in the Imperial Camp.

Let's see what we've got here... Information on three caches containing dark artifacts, but no specific location. All we know is that they're somewhere in the vicinity of the Southern Bank...
Well, I guess we'll just have to comb through that entire area and get to them before the mafia does. So don't delay!
Think of a place where we could've made a cache and look in there...

There! These are the missing artifacts! These and several dozen others. But I suspect that they're already past the Cordon.
Well, we've done all that we could - the traitors are dead and the artifacts have been returned to our people.
Report on the kobold attack to Colonel Steeler the Righteous in the Imperial Camp.

An interesting tablet... Burnt clay with badly drawn sketches that resemble a child's doodles.
However, the content of these drawings clearly isn't childish - a necklace of beheaded human heads, hanging from the neck of a bizarre creature with many tentacles...
What could it mean?
Whatever it is, we better tell the brass about the kobold attack and show them this tablet.
Kobolds? Hmm, probably just another artifact hunter! Guess their own treasures aren't enough, so they want to snatch ours!

Trash that thing, will ya? Who cares what those subterranean beasts are up to!
We've got bigger fish to fry! The battle for the Rusted Wasteland is in full swing!
Report on the Kobold attack to the Gallant Family in the League Camp.

An interesting tablet... Burnt clay with badly drawn sketches that resemble a child's doodles.
However, the content of these drawings clearly isn't childish - a necklace of beheaded human heads, hanging from the neck of a bizarre creature with many tentacles...
What could it mean?
Whatever it is, we better tell the brass about the kobold attack and show them this tablet.

Kobolds? You mean those vicious little stinkers that live underground?
I bet they're after artifacts as well!

A strange tablet, indeed. It's too bad we don't have the time to devote to this puzzle.
We've at war! We'll have plenty of time to decipher these scribbles after we win.
Collect 6 Rusty Skulls from the Rusted Wasteland for Semer Sanakht.

Unfortunately, we'll have to take a break from our artifact research and classification.
Honestly, is there anything worse than army goons sticking their noses into science? Steeler the Righteous is convinced that learning how skeletons survive in the conditions of the anomaly has become a priority for us. What's there to learn - they're skeletons, for Astral's sake! And now all the artifact-related data I've crammed into my brain over the past several weeks is to be cast aside. Just like that, 'cause he said so! Now we're supposed to worry about the skeletons!
Alas, I am a scientist but also a public servant - I don't have any choice in the matter. And neither do you. So, on that note, go bring me some skeleton skulls from the Rusted Wasteland.
Ugh, instead of studying artifacts, I'm stuck here with these skeletons!
Thanks! I finally get a capable assistant and then I have to conclude my artifact research. Figures!
Use the Magical Poison Gland on 6 dead Stone Elementals. Collect 6 Softened Elemental Shards for Semer Sanakht.

Let's get back to my experiments. To the Astral with those skeletons! The Dark Artifacts are a much bigger priority!
I'm especially interested in the Magical Poison Gland. If we manage to learn the nature of its magical effect... Then the League knights and warriors will become nothing more than slugs... Just waiting to be crushed and ground into nothingness!
So far we've tested the Magical Poison Gland effect on the scorpions. I wonder... How will the artifact affect stone elementals? That's the question! And to get the answer you'll need to travel to the Rusted Wasteland. The mechanism is the same: use the Gland, get the softened elemental shard, and bring it to me. Or rather, them. I need six of them.
And be careful! There are plenty of League soldiers in the area, and the elementals themselves are dangerous enemies. Watch yourself. And don't forget that from here on out your life belongs to science and only science!
So the rock elementals melted from the artifact, eh?

Aha! With regard to rock elementals, the effect actually exceeded our expectations!
The conclusion is: the stronger the flesh, the greater the effect from the Magical Poison Gland. Let's make a note of it here.
Find the lost documents from the ship wreck on Midnight Shore for Steeler the Righteous at the Imperial Camp.

I have another important mission for you. Something like "I came, I saw, I stole". Do you accept?
A vessel of ours crashed on the Midnight Shore. And if that weren't enough, its debris washed ashore not far from the League camp. Worst of all, the ship was transporting top secret documents!
The pathetic crew that allowed their ship to be destroyed is no more. That means that if these documents end up in the League's hands, it's you and I who will suffer the consequences! If that happens, you better start packing sweaters 'cause we'll be in Siveria in no time! Or worse - bound in the City Council's dungeons! I'm not joking! We need to get on that ship and find these documents at any cost!
Don't tell me that there aren't any documents in that ship wreck!

What is this? Orders from the League... "... We have reason to believe that the Empire will send a spy to look for the documents we've salvaged from the ship wreck..." No! The League got their dirty paws on our documents!
Confiscate 3 Dark Artifacts for Semer Kiya.

Our spy from the League camp reports that a group of smugglers pitched camp on the Midnight Shore and that the League soldiers are unloading heaps of Dark Artifacts on them.
See, that's what happens when your country lacks a clearly defined ideology. Its citizens are craven, small-minded, and willing to sell out their Motherland for a handful of gold. Which plays right into our hands.
The smugglers must've amassed plenty of artifacts by now. Your mission is to make your way into the smuggler's camp and get them back. After all, they are Imperial property!

They say the League has no intentions of using the artifacts... They just want to destroy them!
Those wretched retrogrades!
These artifacts could've easily become enemy property, but ended up in our depot. And it's all because they've got traitors in their midst. The League won't last long with that kind of discipline!
Sneak into the League Camp and light 3 Tents on fire for Steeler the Righteous.

That damned League camp receives so many reinforcements that they can't even fit all of their soldiers within the camp walls! They have to house them in tents outside. We'd be foolish not to exploit this!
You could sneak up to their tents with a lit torch in your hands... and unleash the dragon!
...I mean light them afire. So, how do you like my idea? Just stay away from the center of the camp - that's way too dangerous. The tents that are further off are the perfect target.
Sneak over there and light ‘em up! In my day, wars were not always won with axes. A pity, but what can you do...
The League soldiers' cries as they burned were so loud that our boys could hear them all the way over here! Good job!
Sneak into the League Camp and pour the poison in 5 Barrels of Water for Steeler the Righteous at the Imperial Camp.

I've got another great sabotage idea. My old man was a real cutthroat and he taught me that all is fair in love and war. You know how the shamans cry about "honest warfare" on every corner? Well, let's just say if the Orcs were to follow their advice, we would have been extinct long ago.
Have you ever handle poison before?
All the drinking water in the League camp is stored in barrels. I've got a few vials of poison that will help our boys at the Wasteland to a much easier fight, haha! I've instructed the doc to find me the strongest poison available, and this is what he gave me.
Poison the water in the League Camp - not even in the bowels of the City Council could they come up with such a devious plan!
Excellent! Now let's just wait and see what happens!
Kill 6 League Veterans and return to Steeler the Righteous.

Listen, I've got another great idea.
I want to put together an honors board right here in the camp. We'll record the names of the Empire's best soldiers on it. But I need something to get this thing off the ground. So I thought - how about you show initiative and lead by example.
For starters, you'll need to kill six League soldiers. We'll spread the news among the Imperial forces, and the other soldiers will want to try and beat you! Someone else will kill seven, and then another will kill eight. I'm sure we'll be done well before the number even reaches a hundred - the League will run out of soldiers!
How many soldiers did you kill?
Excellent! I've already spoken with the troops. The Daredevil Company went nuts for the idea. It'll be great!
Activate the Red Rag by the cave that the deserters are hiding in near the Imperial camp for the Gallant Family.

Our scouts report that reinforcements have arrived at the Imperial camp. And guess what kind of battalion they are? A penal battalion! Hah!
Half of the group fled the camp before the new troops even settled into the barracks. Now that's what I call loyalty and dedication!
The defectors have since holed up like rats in a series of caves not far from the Imperial camp. We got this idea to sic them against one another even more. We found a rare artifact called a "Red Rag." Yes, it's from the Wasteland... So, not a word to the Inquisitor! Go and activate it by the caves where the escaped soldiers are hiding. Let them all destroy each other, while we watch and laugh!
I don't like the way Azarias is looking at us... Let's hope he doesn't suspect anything!

So, did the Red Rag work? Tell me what happened!
Did the soldiers turn on each other?! Wonderful!
I mean, that's a shame... Such artifacts could be of great use at the time of war! But we didn't say that, no. It's a dark artifact, we know that...
Collect 6 chunks of Scorpion Meat for the Steamy Family.

Didn't we ask you not to tell anyone about the spider soup?! Oh, you're not the one who started the rumors... Sorry, then.
We don't know what to do! The whole camp is gossiping about some nonsense, saying that we're feeding our soldiers poisoned spider soup. It's a dirty lie, we tell you! We only tried to be creative and take care of your troops with little to no provisions! We can't believe that this is the gratitude we get!
Well, if someone was brave enough to travel south past the Imperial camp there are some fine, fat scorpions in that area. Now they could make a meal worthy of our soldiers! Do you think you could manage to bring us some scorpion meat?
The spiders in our soup aren't poisonous! They're just stringy! Just where do you propose we obtain better quality meat?
This looks so juicy! We can already smell the wonderful, nutritious aroma of spicy scorpion stew!
Collect 6 pieces of Raw Moss for Helene de Grandeur.

What possessed us to come out here? Hurk ack ack ack... Look, I'm getting it too! It's all this sand - it clogs up your lungs! A good portion of our troops are suffering from it. There's two in the infirmary as we speak, coughing their lungs out. I'm worried they'll be traveling to Purgatory before too soon.
Ack hack...We must do something about this as soon as possible. I only know of one surefire remedy... It's made from raw moss. But where would you find it in this steppe?!
We mustn't give up! I heard that there are termites to the south of here. They could've hauled some moss in from the west to line their mounds. Could you take a look and maybe get some moss for me?
Hurkak... How are your lungs? Hack... Are you coughing now too?
Uhuck uck... Ugh, I feel terrible! Hurry, hack... give me the moss, I need to go prepare the medicine right away... Thanks again!...
